name: domiciledb
description: Self-hosted home inventory built to prove what you owned and get paid after a disaster.

comments.overrides: Pin @emnapi/* (optional+peer wasm deps from sharp/transitive) to consistent versions; works around an npm bug where the lockfile writer and `npm ci` validator disagree, which otherwise breaks `npm ci` in CI and Docker. brace-expansion@1/@5 and sharp are pinned to their fixed releases for GHSA-3jxr-9vmj-r5cp (ReDoS) and GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj (libvips runtime CVEs); the sharp override also lifts next's bundled 0.34.x copy past the vuln. brace-expansion@5 is additionally held at 5.0.8 for GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg (unbounded expand() output -> uncatchable OOM); that advisory covers everything <=5.0.7 with no backport to the 1.x line, so brace-expansion@1 stays at 1.1.16 and is suppressed in osv-scanner.toml -- it is dev-only (ESLint 9's minimatch@3) and cannot be lifted, because brace-expansion 5 replaced the callable CommonJS default export with a named `expand`, which makes minimatch@3 throw at require time.
comments.typescript: Held on the 6.x line (^6.0.3, not pinned) because typescript-eslint hard-errors at require time on TS 7.0 -- 'typescript-eslint does not support TS 7.0' -- which takes ESLint down entirely, not just the type-aware rules. typescript-eslint's peer range is >=4.8.4 <6.1.0 and TS >=7.1 support is tracked in typescript-eslint/typescript-eslint#10940. Move to 7.x only once typescript-eslint ships support; Renovate's TS 7 PR is intentionally left open until then.
